Yo bhada (300 AUD) bhandaa aghi maile bherai pathaeko thiye — Mr. Chen lai **AUD 300.00** (Transfer ID: `btr_b653bb8dd8c14d61`) gako chha, ajjai.

Ke tapaile **arko 300 AUD** pathaunu chahanu hunchha (dui choti bhada), ki tyo pahilo transfer nai bhannu khojnu bhayeko ho?

Dobara pathaunu parne bhaye "ho, arko 300 pathau" bhanera confirm garnus.
